description: Fallback-policy ingress matrix, instance leg UNSET so the library default applies (DefaultStrings.java:473 installs fallbackOnMissingTranslationOrNoMatchingAlternative). A ru request against fallback en gives exactly two candidates, so the policy is genuinely consulted (:731 skips the call at the last candidate). Two distinct failure reasons in one catalog separate all three policy values: Items.Sparse declares only ONE/OTHER, so itemCount 5 selects Russian MANY and raises the 'Missing Cardinality translation for MANY' IllegalStateException = RESOLUTION_FAILURE; Items.EnOnly is simply absent from ru = MISSING_TRANSLATION. Verified by execution that the sparse placeholder LOADS (LocalizedStringValidator does not require complete cardinality coverage) and fails only at resolution.

Items.Sparse.commentary: Only ONE and OTHER declared, though Russian also selects FEW and MANY. Reaching MANY throws inside getInternal, which getResult classifies as RESOLUTION_FAILURE.
